youtube.aciklama: Children with autism spectrum disorder may not respond to their name or to speech, so families often suspect hearing loss first. Hearing loss can also occur in autistic children, so hearing should be measured before lack of response is put down to autism. Conversely, if social communication differences persist in a child with hearing loss, assessment for autism should not be delayed.
